accepted.rationale: Published destination Plus Code is explicitly labeled for Suối Đá Bàn and independently repeated for the named ecotourism destination. It is used only as a general area anchor, not an entrance or waterfall point.

evidence.source: Sun World Hòn Thơm destination guide
evidence.finding: Explicitly publishes 'Vị trí Suối Đá Bàn: 62WG+5RF' in the Phú Quốc destination context.
The named entity 'Khu du lịch sinh thái (Suối Đá Bàn)' resolves to Plus Code 62WG+5RF in Cửa Dương.
Independent destination listings repeat 62WG+5RF for Khu du lịch sinh thái (Suối Đá Bàn).

alternate_rejected_for_canonical_area_an.reason: A separate named Suối Đá Bàn POI resolves to this code farther inside the attraction area. It may represent an interior attraction/waterfall POI and is not better evidence for the general destination anchor.

safety_note: Canonical point is deliberately area_anchor. Do not present it as gate, parking, trailhead, waterfall tier, or water-access point.
